what: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
title: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
text: unofficial R package Supabase. supports dual-backend design: DBI/PostgreSQL backend direct database access REST API backend via PostgREST. backends expose identical function signatures — unified sb_* wrappers auto-dispatch whichever backend available, can call sb_db_* / sb_api_* directly.

title: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
text: Supabase now issues four types API keys. supported:

title: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
text: [!NOTE] Connection Modes: Get credentials Connect tab Supabase Dashboard (Project Settings > Database > Connection Strings). three modes work: Direct Connection, Transaction Pooler, Session Pooler. Direct connection doesn’t work, try Transaction Session Pooler. sure use correct host, user, password chosen mode.
code: SUPABASE_HOST=db.xxx.supabase.co # From your chosen connection mode SUPABASE_PORT=6543 # optional; defaults to 6543 assuming a pooled connection SUPABASE_DBNAME=postgres SUPABASE_USER=postgres.xxx # Format varies by connection mode SUPABASE_PASSWORD=your_password SUPABASE_SCHEMA=public # optional; defaults to "public"

title: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
text: backends can active time. startup message shows detected:
code: # New-format keys (recommended) SUPABASE_URL=https://xxx.supabase.co SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_... SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=sb_secret_... # optional; bypasses RLS when present  # Legacy JWT keys (still supported; deprecation warning shown on load) # SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=eyJ... # SUPABASE_ROLE_KEY=eyJ... library(supabaseR) > supabaseR v1.0.0 >   DBI Backend: ✔ >   API Backend: ✔

title: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
text: Use sb_connect() auto-detect best available backend, call unified sb_* wrappers:
code: sb_connect() # picks DBI if available, otherwise REST API  sb_tables() sb_read("users", limit = 10) sb_query("users", where = list(age = list(gt = 18))) sb_insert("users", data.frame(name = "Alice")) sb_update("users", data = list(name = "Bob"), where = list(id = 1)) sb_delete("users", where = list(id = 1))  sb_disconnect()

title: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
code: sb_db_connect() > ✔ Connected to db.xxx.supabase.co  sb_db_tables() sb_db_schema("users") sb_db_read("users", limit = 10)  # Query with operators sb_db_query("users", where = list(id = 1)) sb_db_query("users", where = list(age = list(gt = 18))) sb_db_query("users", where = list(name = list(like = "A%"))) sb_db_query("users", where = list(id = list("in" = c(1, 2, 3))))  # Raw SQL sb_db_query(sql = "SELECT * FROM public.users WHERE id = 1")  # Write sb_db_insert("users", data.frame(name = "Alice")) > ✔ Inserted 1 row into users  sb_db_update("users", data = list(name = "Bob"), where = list(id = 1)) > ✔ Updated 1 row in users  sb_db_upsert("users", data.frame(id = 1, name = "Charlie"), conflict_columns = "id") > ✔ Upserted 1 row into users  sb_db_delete("users", where = list(id = 1)) > ✔ Deleted 1 row from users  sb_db_disconnect() > ✔ Disconnected

title: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
text: Note: Raw SQL (sql = parameter) supported DBI backend. sb_api_query() uses PostgREST filter operators instead.
code: sb_api_connect() > ✔ API credentials set for https://xxx.supabase.co  sb_api_tables() sb_api_schema("users") sb_api_read("users", limit = 10)  # Query with operators (same vocabulary as DBI) sb_api_query("users", where = list(id = 1)) sb_api_query("users", where = list(age = list(gt = 18))) sb_api_query("users", where = list(name = list(like = "A%"))) sb_api_query("users", where = list(id = list("in" = c(1, 2, 3))))  # Write sb_api_insert("users", data.frame(name = "Alice")) sb_api_update("users", data = list(name = "Bob"), where = list(id = 1)) sb_api_upsert("users", data.frame(id = 1, name = "Charlie"), conflict_columns = "id") sb_api_delete("users", where = list(id = 1))  sb_api_disconnect() > ✔ API credentials cleared

title: Connect to Supabase via REST API — sb_api_connect
text: url Supabase URL (default: SUPABASE_URL env var) key Supabase API key. Accepts legacy anon JWT key new publishable key (sb_publishable_...). Optional secret_key provided. (default: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env var) secret_key Supabase secret key. Accepts legacy service_role JWT key new secret key (sb_secret_...). present used requests, bypassing Row Level Security. (default: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY SUPABASE_ROLE_KEY env var)

title: supabaseR 1.0.0 (2026-04-07)
text: Dual-backend design: DBI/PostgreSQL (sb_db_*) Supabase REST API (sb_api_*), unified wrappers (sb_*) auto-dispatch. Full CRUD backends: read, query, insert, update, upsert, delete, truncate. Table metadata helpers: tables, table_exists, schema. filter operators across backends: gt, lt, gte, lte, neq, like, ilike, , . Raw SQL supported DBI backend. four Supabase key formats supported. Secret / service-role keys bypass Row Level Security (RLS) automatically. Deprecation warnings legacy JWT keys. SUPABASE_SCHEMA env var honoured backends via get_schema(). CLI startup message load showing backends detected. pkgdown documentation website deepanshkhurana.github.io/supabaseR
